title: Functional Validation
description:
**OUR STORY**

  

**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**

  

**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**

  

**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**

**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**

**YOUR ROLE**

Lab validation and characterization
  

Attached to the Imaging Validation department, you will join a dynamic and innovative team, an integral part of R\&D, working on projects at the state of the art of image sensor technology targeting various markets and applications.


As a Functional Validation Engineer, you will be involved in validating all the division products. This activity will aim to ensure the adequacy of the functionalities and performances of the product with the specifications by relying on FPGA prototyping first, and on circuit silicon in a second time.


In this context, you will be responsible for developing the validation environment (definition of the tests suite, of the test bench in the laboratory, of the hardware, development of stimuli, automation, documentation). To do this, you will benefit from the different areas of technical expertise of our employees in testing, optics, electronics, mechanics, and software development.


Throughout the validation, you will also oversee the analysis and resolution of technical challenges. Your product expertise may also be called upon to participate in customer support and integration.


To succeed in these missions, you will work in close collaboration with all the different product development teams (Design, Architecture, Firmware and embedded software development), with our application teams in order to provide the best validation solution that will meet our customer's needs.


You will also participate in project meetings, sharing information, actions, and priorities within the team.


Finally, as a member of a validation team, you will reuse existing tools. You will also propose and participate in methods and tools for improvements.


**YOUR SKILLS \& EXPERIENCES**

o Object\-oriented programming languages (preferably Python, C)
  

o Version management tools (git, svn)
  

o Software, Hardware knowledge and debug capabilities.
  

* Knowledge:

o Embedded electronics / computing (real time)
Exp: 7 to 12yrs
  

o Laboratory tools (oscilloscope, signal generator, etc.)
  

o Transmission protocols (high and low speed): I2C, I3C, SPI, MIPI
  

o Automation and/or continuous integration tools (ex: Jenkins, Gerrit, AI tools)
  

o Notions in image processing would be an adding competency.  



ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics \& integrity, purpose \& values, organization \& change, business strategy, and performance.


At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.  



  

To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

title: Engineer - Electrical Engineering
description:
The Electrical Design Engineer within Generator \& Electrical Systems(GES) organization will play a pivotal role in designing, analyzing, and optimizing products within the Gas Power portfolio. This role involves working across various stages of the product lifecycle, from initial design through field issue resolution. The engineer will ensure technical excellence, safety, and performance of electrical components and systems through advanced analysis, innovative design, and continuous improvement.
**Job Description**
===================


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Design and analyze electrical components applicable to LV, MV and HV systems across the Generator and Electrical product portfolio.
* Create design documentation, including single line diagrams, wiring and elementary drawings, loop diagrams, specifications, layouts, and other arrangement drawings.
* Serve as the Lead Design Engineer (LDE) or Lead Electrical Engineer (LEE) on new build projects and act as the Single Point of Contact (SPoC) for the electrical engineering scope.
* Prepare functional specifications for electrical components, electrical interconnections, and interface documents based on sizing studies, contractual requirements, and applicable regulatory codes and standards (e.g., IEC, NEC, CSA, IECEx, ATEX), and reference designs.
* Lead and support new vendor qualification activities in collaboration with GEV Sourcing.
* Perform and support Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and develop Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) to improve product reliability, quality, and performance.
* Support supplier design evaluations and the technical assessment and disposition of supplier offers.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to interpret \& develop Single Line Diagrams and develop wiring, loop, instrumentation, and schematic diagrams. Apply electrical design principles to adapt and improve overall system design.
* Take technical ownership of electrical hardware and systems.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to support project execution and process improvement.
* Participate in peer and design reviews, develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including Controlled Title Holders, analysis experts, and global engineering sites, and contribute to solving complex engineering problems.
* Comply with R\&D processes, local codes \& standards, manage project milestones, and seek peer validation to ensure technical quality and design integrity.
* Support tendering and bidding activities through engineering calculations, technical assessments, and recommendations.
* Embrace LEAN principles and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING \- Basic Qualifications:**


* Bachelor of Science (B.S.) or Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 0 –2 years of experience in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, Site Installation \& Commissioning and/or Manufacturing Quality Engineering Function.
  

**WHAT WILL MAKE YOU STAND OUT \- Desired Qualifications:**


* Strong focus on safety, quality, execution, and process/execution rigor.
* Open\-minded, self\-motivated, and empowered to challenge conventional thinking, explore innovative solutions, and take calculated risks.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with team members and customers while contributing to an inclusive work environment.
* Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities based on business needs.
* Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to communicate transparently and deliver project milestones.
* Ability to break down complex problems and develop and execute effective solutions.
* Familiarity with AI tools and a continuous improvement mindset, with an understanding of Lean principles.
* Basic programming knowledge in Python, with the ability to apply it to engineering data analysis, simulation, or automation.
* Familiarity with electrical simulation software and/or power system analysis tools, such as MATLAB/Simulink, ETAP, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSS/E, and PSCAD.

description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------



To be a driven business analyst who can work on complex Analytical problems and help the customer in better business decision making especially in the area of pharma/life sciences (domain).


**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Role Overview**



The Snowflake Developer is responsible for building and optimizing data pipelines and analytical datasets within a Snowflake\-based data lakehouse. This role also includes leveraging **Snowflake Cortex** to enable AI\-driven data transformations, natural language processing, and intelligent data applications directly within the data platform.



**Key Responsibilities**


**1\. Data Ingestion \& Integration**


* Develop and maintain scalable data ingestion pipelines (batch and near real\-time).
* Load data from databases, APIs, files, and streaming systems into Snowflake.
* Handle structured and semi\-structured data (JSON, Parquet, Avro, CSV).
* Integrate Snowflake with cloud storage platforms (S3, Azure Data Lake, GCS).


**2\. Data Transformation (ELT)**


* Build ELT pipelines using Snowflake SQL and native features (Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables).
* Implement transformations across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers.
* Use tools like dbt for modular, reusable, and testable transformations.


**3\. Snowflake Cortex \& AI Enablement**


* Leverage **Snowflake Cortex** functions within SQL for AI\-powered transformations.
* Implement use cases such as:
* + Text summarization of large datasets (logs, documents)
	+ Sentiment analysis and classification
	+ Natural language enrichment of datasets
* Work with vector embeddings and similarity search for semantic use cases.
* Assist in building AI\-ready datasets for downstream analytics and ML.
* Collaborate with data scientists to integrate AI/ML logic into Snowflake pipelines.
* Support simple **prompt engineering** within Cortex functions for optimized outputs.


**4\. Data Modeling**


* Design and implement analytical data models (star schema, snowflake schema).
* Build fact and dimension tables optimized for BI and AI use cases.
* Ensure datasets are structured for both analytics and AI consumption.


**5\. Performance \& Cost Optimization**


* Optimize SQL queries and Snowflake workloads.
* Use clustering, caching, and efficient compute strategies.
* Monitor warehouse usage and control costs, including Cortex consumption.


**6\. Data Quality \& Validation**


* Implement data validation checks and quality frameworks.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data.
* Debug and resolve pipeline and data issues.


**7\. Security \& Governance**


* Apply RBAC, masking policies, and row\-level security.
* Ensure compliance with data governance and privacy standards.
* Maintain proper documentation and lineage for datasets.


**8\. Collaboration \& Agile Delivery**


* Work with architects, analysts, and AI/ML teams.
* Translate business and AI use cases into technical implementations.
* Participate in Agile development processes.
